pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against pyramiding or executing multiple concurrent tickets within a 30-second window during high volatility intervals to prevent clustered drawdowns.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require mandatory multi-timeframe order book imbalance confirmation and absolute avoidance of entries within 5 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic news wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively lock in gains when floating profits hit the +$15.00 to +$30.00 band via dynamic trailing activations, completely eliminating premature micro-exits under +$1.00.
